git_scope: A full clone of mohsensbu-jpg/square_packing_records_karimi, fetched for the intake pass of 31 October; the repository holds one commit, ad8b094 (committed 2026-10-31T11:40:48Z, 'Copies of Zenodo deposits, unchanged'), of seven files, and the scope is the whole tree. The author named this commit on #836 (2026-10-31T11:43:02Z) and #847 (11:43:36Z) as unchanged copies of his Zenodo records 23664800 (v5.0), 23819397 (V2.0) and 23681705 (V1.0), after the acknowledgements said zenodo.org was unreachable from this environment. zenodo.org was still refused by the session's network policy (proxy 403) when this packet was written, so no Zenodo listing was read. Every digest the issues state matches: karimi_two_strip_records_v3_lite.zip 9c70c4d8...6325 and its records.csv member 7e78c15d...e941 (#836); filled_records.csv 1cbfecf8...48f5 (#847); karimi_filled_end_v2.zip f1684581...7cfa97 and its filled_records.csv member f047c44b...0b56 (#836's comment of 27 October). filled_ends.py, regenerate_filled.py and check_cert.py carry no stated digest of their own, but each is byte-identical to the member of the same name in karimi_filled_end_v2.zip, whose digest the author stated on 27 October; README_filled.md (V2.0) and the v5 zip's README.md have no stated digest and are pinned by this commit alone. No source program ran in writing this packet.
license: CC BY 4.0 for every file, the code also MIT, each as the author states it. The v5 archive's README.md states 'License: data CC BY 4.0; code MIT.' For V2.0 (Zenodo 23819397) and V1.0 (23681705), whose README_filled.md states no licence, the author answered on #847 on 31 October 2026 at 16:22:49Z (issuecomment-6546015739): both are published under CC BY 4.0, which covers all files of each record, data and code, and the code files may also be used under the MIT licence, as with v5. The repository has no licence file, and the Zenodo records' own licence metadata was not readable from this environment, so the licence rests on the author's statements. The files were retained before that answer under the presumption of permission the owner set on 24 October 2026 for a source its author submits (think-cnn7); the answer settles the follow-up on think-nu37.
claims: karimi_two_strip_records_v3_lite.zip is Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23664800 (v5.0, 2026-10-26), #836: records.csv holds 5,308 rows at n = 1182 to 9944, each an exact side below ceil(sqrt n) with the two-strip parameters K, mH, tH, phH, mV, tV and phV and the author's flag below_all_reported (51 rows 'no'); regenerate.py is byte-identical to versions 1 and 2's (67c861dc...a04f).

filled_records.csv, filled_ends.py, regenerate_filled.py, check_cert.py and README_filled.md are Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23819397 (V2.0, 2026-10-30), #847: 5,134 rows at n = 1182 to 9946 of the filled-end two-band L packing, each an exact side with K, bV, tV, yV, bH, tH and yH. README_filled.md credits the L frame to Sungjoon Ryu (Theorem 1.3), the axis-layer fill of the band ends to Evan Daniel (evand/square-packing, certificates/k2-minus-c/), written as in Kevin Fang's note (10.5281/zenodo.23624565, Sections 2-3), and the independent band parameters and the per-n search to Mohsen Karimi, with Claude assistance disclosed.

karimi_filled_end_v2.zip is Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23681705 (V1.0, 2026-10-27), posted on #836 and superseded by V2.0 in #847: its filled_records.csv holds 4,571 rows at n = 1184 to 9946; its README_filled.md differs from V2.0's, and its three programs are V2.0's byte for byte.
